reference: Travel notes for Amsterdam. Flying out Tuesday, June 25 — JFK Terminal 4 at 6:15 AM. Landing in Amsterdam at 8:30 PM local time. Hotel is the Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht, on the canal. Check-in at 3 PM, might need to drop bags first. Dinner reservation at Rijks restaurant on Wednesday the 26th at 7:30 PM. Thursday: Anne Frank House booked at 9 AM — do not be late, they're very strict about timed entries. Flying back Saturday the 28th at 2 PM Amsterdam time. Leave the hotel by 10:30 AM at the latest — Schiphol is about 40 minutes away and security takes forever.
